Mette Ringtved is a nursing director (*Sygeplejefaglig direktør*) at Regionshospitalet Horsens in the Central Denmark Region (*Region Midtjylland*) [^src1]. She serves as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] (AFDK Steering Group) [^src1]. Her participation in this group underscores the inclusion of nursing leadership in the coordination of healthcare quality metrics and clinical governance [^src1]. 

The steering group is responsible for overseeing the "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" (*Atrieflimren i Danmark*) report, an initiative that analyzes critical clinical outcomes, wait times for anticoagulation treatment, and the incidence of ischemic stroke and intracranial hemorrhage among atrial fibrillation patients across the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Because the available corpus data is thin, her specific contributions to the committee's decisions are not detailed beyond her formal membership, professional title, and institutional affiliation [^src1].
